title: Worth seeing
text:
Was not convenient getting tickets downloaded. The tickets were actually through viator, why go through trip advisor?  

The house itself is a must see. Did the self guided and was great.  Well worth the cost.
author: Vacationer493554

title: Well organized self...
text: Well organized self guided tour of this incredible, talented architect. Although lines appeared long, the flow through the space gave plenty of opportunity to enjoy and take in the surrounding beauty. Do not miss this!
author: CarolJoAnne_C

title: Great Tour ! Bring a FAN !!!
text: Great Tour! Just make sure to bring a fan it’s right in the middle of the sun with no shade and super hot while waiting to get in. 10:/10 recommend. Tickets were sent to me via WhatsApp
author: markbE831WZ

title: What a beautiful design!
text: Excellent!  You will love it!  A little tip: Choose the terrace option, and when you get there,  have a glass of cava from the bar up top. Sit at a table under an umbrella. And if it’s a summer day, choose a time as late in the day as possible to avoid extreme heat.
author: Passport784799

title: Casa Battló Nice
text:
Casa Battló was my first Gaudí building and it did not disappoint. It was very nice with some amazing architecture and views. 

I wonder how long the family lived there after the building was completed. 

I did the Blue ticket and feel that was good, the audio commentary was very good.
author: stevehJ4079PK

title: Astounding archive
text: Casa Batilo is a truly fantastic experience. Gaudi did a truly amazing job of combining form and function. Every level of the house is an artistic masterpiece.
author: BillC612

title: Casa Batllo
text: Wonderful audio tour. Allows you to understand the brilliance of Gaudi and his exquisite use of color. The video at the end was amazing!
author: bethn833

title: Casa Batllo / House of bones
text:
Easy to navigate your with audio to describe all elements of this beautiful building.
Plenty of photo opportunities, make sure you do not mind lots of stairs as several floors to climb
author: Donna_P

title: Barcelona
text: Easy smooth transactions no issues on arrival no lines! The tour is automated headphones pretty cool. Great experience and photos!
